# gns3_project (List Resource)

Lists every project on the GNS3 controller, opened or closed (`GET /v2/projects`). Takes no arguments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List resources need Terraform 1.14 or later. Put this file beside the root
# module's .tf files and run: terraform query
list "gns3_project" "all" {
  provider = gns3
}
```
